answer: Transfer-entropy lead-lag screening: for every pair of identities in the orchard, compute Granger-style transfer entropy between their activity streams (answer timing, grade order, word choice pigment). Honest agents show weak, symmetric coupling; clones driven by one controller show a sharp directed lead-lag where one stream predicts the other beyond chance. Pairs above a quartz-hard threshold, verified on a fresh beacon-picked window, are folded into one reward share, and the fold is lifted only after a month of independent streams. Splitting a controller adds coupling, not reward.
